Interface TenantContext

public interface TenantContext
Programmatic tenant binding for callers that have no incoming-request context — background jobs, integration tests, and control-plane code.

This is the single source of truth for the effective tenant: both the Hibernate CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver and the Postgres session-GUC setter call current(), never the TenantResolver directly. That single read point is what prevents a split brain where bind(B) would steer Hibernate to tenant B but the Postgres GUC would still resolve to the default.

This interface is not part of the frozen SPI. The commercial edition may ship its own implementation; its shape may evolve with semantic-version discipline because no third-party code consumes it.

Typical usage

try (var bound = tenantContext.bind(tenantId)) {
    // inside this block, Hibernate filters and the Postgres GUC are
    // pinned to tenantId — regardless of what TenantResolver would say
}
Binds nest correctly: a nested bind() pushes onto a per-thread stack and the returned AutoCloseable pops it.

  • Method Details

    • current

      UUID current()
      Returns:
      the effective tenant id for this thread of execution: the most recent bind(UUID) that has not yet been closed, or — if none is bound — whatever the configured TenantResolver returns. Never null.

    • bind

      AutoCloseable bind(UUID tenantId)
      Pin the effective tenant for the current thread to tenantId until the returned handle is closed.
      Parameters:
      tenantId - non-null tenant id to bind
      Returns:
      an AutoCloseable that unbinds the tenant when closed (idempotent and re-entrant)
